set.body:
Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-1.0; milestone-video.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: Recorded AC4-S1 follow-up: current join compares sha/count/geometry. It belongs before multipart loader/executed-frame qualification; preserve existing caption receipt behavior and worker schema compatibility.

Remaining / next action: Bind CaptionRequest to the actual frame-selection identity using versioned request wire, and make CaptionExtent checked/unforgeable. Prove same-digest/count different-selection refusal plus an accepting control and outside-package construction courts.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Follow-up from the AC4-S1 cold review (finding 3, and the rule-8 root of finding 1). CaptionSearch.requestDescribes compares only sha, count and geometry, so a request issued for selection A joins sampled frames of selection B with the same declared digest and count. Carry frames.identity, or a selection digest, in CaptionRequest (a worker wire change: caption-request schema v2) and check it at the join. Also make CaptionExtent a final non-case class whose only construction is CaptionExtent.of, which removes the forged-shape door the join now re-checks. Belongs with AC4-S2/S3.
